'''Bostik''' is a manufacturer and distributor of [[Adhesive|adhesives]] and sealants for the construction, industrial and consumer markets. With annual sales of €2.7 billion in 2024, the company employs over 7,000 people and has a presence in more than 45 countries. Bostik is part of the French-based [[Arkema]] group.

== History ==
In 1889, the Boston Blacking Company, a producer of leather colourings and dyes, was founded in [[Chelsea, Massachusetts]]. The company became the chemical branch of [[United Shoe Machinery Corporation]] (USMC) – an American leader in the shoemaking industry – and grew in several countries through mergers, acquisitions and organic growth.

By the late 1920s, the Boston Blacking Company was established in 12 countries across three continents and employed over 1,000 chemists and technicians. A number of products had been launched under the Bostik brand as early as the 1940s and the company took on Bostik as a company name in the 1960s.

In 1980, Bostik was taken over by the Connecticut group Emhart Corporation, which nine years later was, itself, bought up by [[Black+Decker|Black & Decker]]. Black & Decker split apart the mechanical and chemical activities of the group to leave Bostik as a stand-alone concern.

In 1990, the French oil and gas group [[TotalEnergies|Total]] acquired Bostik and merged its own adhesive affiliates into it.

In 2000, Totalfina and Elf Aquitaine merged to form TotalFinaElf, subsequently renamed Total. Their respective adhesives divisions, Bostik and Atofindley, were brought together to form Bostik Findley, and the name was subsequently changed in 2004 to Bostik.

In 2013 Bostik revisited its brand identity, with a new signature "smart adhesives" and a gecko inspired from nature with a science-based connection to Bostik's adhesives business{{citation needed|date=January 2021}}. In 2015, Arkema, a global chemical major with leadership positions in specialty chemicals and high performance materials, acquired Bostik. In 2019 Bostik won an Adhesives and Sealants Council (ASC) Innovation Award for " "Brilliance" which is an olefin elastic high-performance attachment adhesive."<ref>{{Cite web |title=Innovation Awards - Adhesive and Sealant Council |url=https://www.ascouncil.org/innovation-awards |access-date=2023-08-10 |website=www.ascouncil.org}}</ref> 
[[File:Early 20th Century Dubbin Tin.JPG|thumb|Early 20th century dubbin tin from the Boston Blacking Co. under the Be-Be-Co brand name: Dubb-O]]

==Headquarters building==
{{main|B B Chemical Company}}
In 1937, Boston Blacking built a [[Streamline Moderne]] headquarters building in [[Cambridge, Massachusetts]], signposted as "B B CHEMICAL",<ref>''Manning's Cambridge Directory'', 1946, [https://archive.org/details/manningscambridg1946unse/page/122/mode/2up p. 122]</ref> and used it until 1966. The building has been listed on the [[National Register of Historic Places]] since 1982.<ref name="nris">{{NRISref|2008a}}</ref><ref name=NRHP>{{cite web|url=https://mhc-macris.net/details?mhcid=cam.257|title=MACRIS inventory record and NRHP nomination for B & B Chemical Company|publisher=Commonwealth of Massachusetts|access-date=25 May 2020}}</ref>

== Products ==
Bostik is among the four top [[adhesive]]s and [[sealant]]s producers in the world. Bostik employs over 5,000 workers in 50 countries and five continents.<ref>[http://www.bostik.co.uk/corporate/keyfigures Bostik corporate information] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106002029/http://www.bostik.co.uk/corporate/keyfigures |date=6 January 2009 }} Bostik Limited</ref>

Bostik has a well recognized name in [[Industrial marketing|industrial markets]]{{citation needed|date=January 2021}}. It has some divisions such as: Industrial/Nonwovens, Construction and Distribution, and [[polymers|High-performance polymers]].  Its brands include Bostik, [[Blu Tack]], [[Prestik]], Sader, Quelyd, Simson, Evo-Stik, Alliance, Ardal, Cementone, Mem, Technik, Hey'Di, SB Mercier, Chem-Calk, Hydroment, Durabond, Anchor Weld, Clag, Gripfill, Flexacryl and Aquamac weatherband.<ref>[http://www.bostik.co.uk/corporate/brands Bostik corporate information] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090105230744/http://www.bostik.co.uk/corporate/brands |date=5 January 2009 }} Bostik Limited</ref>

== Rewards ==
Two products have received the approval of professionals and the general public:

* Brilliance: the first high-performance [[Alkene|olefin]] adhesive for fixing elastics,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bostik Offers Smart Adhesive Solutions|url=https://www.nonwovens-industry.com/contents/view_live-from-shows/2018-04-18/bostik-offers-smart-adhesive-solutions/|access-date=12 November 2020|website=Nonwovens Industry Magazine – News, Markets & Analysis for the Nonwovens Industry}}</ref> a patented formulation.<ref>United States Patent (3 January 2017), https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/45/39/12/1b1be998080c16/US9532906.pdf</ref> In 2018, Bostik won the Adhesives and Sealant Council (ASC) trophy for the contribution to innovation of Brilliance™.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bostik's Brilliance Receives Honor|url=https://www.nonwovens-industry.com/contents/view_breaking-news/2018-04-25/bostiks-brilliance-receives-honor/|access-date=12 November 2020|website=Nonwovens Industry Magazine – News, Markets & Analysis for the Nonwovens Industry}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Remington|first=Chris|title=Bostik Brilliance earns industry award|url=https://www.nonwovensnews.com/industrial-products-news/14114-bostik-brilliance-earns-industry-award|access-date=12 November 2020|website=Nonwovens News|language=en-GB}}</ref>
* Fix & Flash: bonding technology which dries in contact with the rays of LED light. Fix & Flash is voted "Product of the year 2019<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bostik : Fix & Flash|url=https://www.poyfrance.com/portfolios/bostik-fix-flash/|access-date=2020-11-12|website=Élu Produit de l’Année|language=fr-FR}}</ref>" in the "repair glue" category.
